file_id: P.Harinadh vs State Of Ap on 24 October, 2019

sentences.text: P.Harinadh vs State Of Ap on 24 October, 2019

Author: T. Rajani
Bench: T. Rajani
 Smt. Justice T. Rajani
 Criminal Petition No. 6370 Of 2019
Order:

This criminal petition, under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, is filed by the petitioners-accused Nos.1 and 2 seeking for quash of the proceedings against them in Crime No.118 of 2019 of Bangarupalem Police Station, Chittoor District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 270, 273, 420 r/w 34 IPC and Sections 24(1) r/w 27 of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce,
Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 (for short, 'the Act of 2003').
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.

entities.text:
Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce,
Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the issues raised in this criminal petition are squarely covered by common order of High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh in Criminal Petition Nos. 3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27.08.2018, whereby the Court quashed the proceedings against the petitioners therein for the offences punishable under Indian Penal Code and Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, while permitting the prosecution to proceed with the offences punishable under the provisions of the Act of 2003.

entities.text: High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Indian Penal Code and Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. Following the said order and in terms thereof, the proceedings against the petitioners for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 270, 273 and 420 r/w 34 IPC are quashed while permitting the prosecution to proceed with the offences punishable under the provisions of the Act of 2003.

The Registry is directed to annex a copy of the order dated 27.08.2018 in Criminal Petition Nos.
3731 of 2018 and batch to this order.
The Criminal Petition is accordingly partly allowed.
As a sequel, the miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.
LMV SMT. JUSTICE T.RAJANI CRIMINAL PETITION No. 6370 OF 2019 DATE: 24-10-2019 LMV P.Harinadh vs State Of Ap on 24 October, 2019
